590: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<Helper> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, final JavacNode annotationNode) {
591: 		if (generationActivity != null) noteGenerationWork("helper");
592: 		activeSourceNode = annotationNode;
593: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.HELPER_FLAG_USAGE, "@Helper");
594: 
595: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, Helper.class);
596: 		JavacNode annotatedType = annotationNode.up();
597: 		JavacNode containingBlock = annotatedType == null ? null : annotatedType.directUp();
598: 		List<JCStatement> origStatements = getStatementsFromJcNode(containingBlock == null ? null : containingBlock.get());
599: 
600: 		if (annotatedType == null || annotatedType.getKind() != Kind.TYPE || origStatements == null) {
601: 			annotationNode.addError("@Helper is legal only on method-local classes.");
602: 			return;
603: 		}
604: 
605: 		JCClassDecl annotatedType_ = (JCClassDecl) annotatedType.get();
606: 		Iterator<JCStatement> it = origStatements.iterator();
607: 		while (it.hasNext()) {
608: 			if (it.next() == annotatedType_) {
609: 				break;
610: 			}
611: 		}
612: 
613: 		java.util.List<String> knownMethodNames = new ArrayList<String>();
614: 
615: 		for (JavacNode ch : annotatedType.down()) {
616: 			if (ch.getKind() != Kind.METHOD) continue;
617: 			String n = ch.getName();
618: 			if (n == null || n.isEmpty() || n.charAt(0) == '<') continue;
619: 			knownMethodNames.add(n);
620: 		}
621: 
622: 		Collections.sort(knownMethodNames);
623: 		final String[] knownMethodNames_ = knownMethodNames.toArray(new String[0]);
624: 
625: 		final Name helperName = annotationNode.toName("$" + annotatedType_.name);
626: 		final boolean[] helperUsed = new boolean[1];
627: 		final JavacTreeMaker maker = annotationNode.getTreeMaker();
628: 
629: 		TreeVisitor<Void, Void> visitor = new TreeScanner<Void, Void>() {
630: 			@Override public Void visitMethodInvocation(MethodInvocationTree node, Void p) {
631: 				JCMethodInvocation jcmi = (JCMethodInvocation) node;
632: 				apply(jcmi);
633: 				return super.visitMethodInvocation(node, p);
634: 			}
635: 
636: 			private void apply(JCMethodInvocation jcmi) {
637: 				if (!(jcmi.meth instanceof JCIdent)) return;
638: 				JCIdent jci = (JCIdent) jcmi.meth;
639: 				if (Arrays.binarySearch(knownMethodNames_, jci.name.toString()) < 0) return;
640: 				jcmi.meth = maker.Select(maker.Ident(helperName), jci.name);
641: 				recursiveSetGeneratedBy(jcmi.meth, annotationNode);
642: 				helperUsed[0] = true;
643: 			}
644: 		};
645: 
646: 		while (it.hasNext()) {
647: 			JCStatement stat = it.next();
648: 			stat.accept(visitor, null);
649: 		}
650: 
651: 		if (!helperUsed[0]) {
652: 			annotationNode.addWarning("No methods of this helper class are ever used.");
653: 			return;
654: 		}
655: 
656: 		ListBuffer<JCStatement> newStatements = new ListBuffer<JCStatement>();
657: 
658: 		boolean mark = false;
659: 		for (JCStatement stat : origStatements) {
660: 			newStatements.append(stat);
661: 			if (mark || stat != annotatedType_) continue;
662: 			mark = true;
663: 			JCExpression init = maker.NewClass(null, List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Ident(annotatedType_.name), List.<JCExpression>nil(), null);
664: 			JCExpression varType = maker.Ident(annotatedType_.name);
665: 			JCVariableDecl decl = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(Flags.FINAL), helperName, varType, init);
666: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(decl, annotationNode);
667: 			newStatements.append(decl);
668: 		}
669: 		setStatementsOfJcNode(containingBlock.get(), newStatements.toList());
670: 	}
